Mixed purées

Green apple and blueberry with curd

Zöldalmás áfonya túrókrémmel

6 months+ Adjusted 20 min 2 portions

Serve from six months, the same day. This contains milk.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 120 g green apple (prepared weight, peeled and cored)
  • 40 g blueberries (fresh or frozen, no added sugar)
  • 100 g pasteurised full-fat curd or cottage cheese (no added salt if you can find it; milk allergen)
  • 40 g plain pasteurised full-fat yogurt (to loosen the curd)

Allergens

milk

Method

  1. Peel, core, and cook the apple with the blueberries until soft.
  2. Squash the berries so the skins burst, then blend the fruit smooth.
  3. Stir the yogurt into the curd until it loosens.
  4. Fold the warm fruit into the curd.
  5. Do not add biscuit crumbs or sugar.

Adjusted

This is often held back until 9 or 10 months for no nutritional reason. Biscuit crumbs are commonly added and are not needed.

Serve it from 6 months, with cooked apple and blueberry stirred into pasteurised curd loosened with yogurt. Leave the biscuit out.
